ai_summary: Adroit Infotech Limited has scheduled a Board Meeting for October 3, 2026, to establish an "Adroit Infotech Employees Welfare Trust." This Trust is intended to facilitate the implementation of the company's AIL ESOP2023, requiring board approvals for trustee appointments, legal documentation, regulatory registrations, and policy adoption. While this move aims to incentivize employees, the actual implementation of the ESOP is contingent on member approval and relevant regulations, potentially leading to future share dilution or financial outlays depending on its final structure.
